meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

howto.what: 在项目里加入 DeltaChat 渠道:安装并注册原生适配器,机器人用专用邮箱账号收发消息,基于 Autocrypt/OpenPGP 端到端加密。适配器直接驱动 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server 子进程。
howto.when: 当你要给项目添加 DeltaChat 渠道,或在 /setup 流程里把 DeltaChat 的私聊、群组接到 agent 时触发。

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to your project: installs and registers the native adapter, which drives the @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server subprocess so the bot sends and receives messages over email with Autocrypt/OpenPGP encryption.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add DeltaChat channel integration to the project, for example while running /setup and wiring a DeltaChat DM or group to an agent.

say_en.text: Add a DeltaChat channel to the project
say_en.note: copies the adapter, installs deps, registers it

say_en.text: Wire my DeltaChat DM to an agent
